data.one_liner: A library to write YAML documents supporting Object encoding and dart:convert Converter.
data.what_it_does: Serializes Dart maps, lists, and objects into properly formatted YAML documents. It handles multiline text, string formatting, and object encoding with options similar to dart:convert's JsonEncoder.
use_when: You need to serialize Dart objects or maps into YAML text strings.
You want to convert Dart data structures into YAML using a 'dart:convert' Converter.
avoid_when: You need to parse or read YAML documents instead of writing them.
strengths: Intelligently formats strings, avoiding unnecessary quotes and handling multiline texts.
weaknesses: Only writes YAML; does not provide reading or parsing capabilities.
